summary: Iteration 15 — verified new auth (email+pass + Emergent Google session exchange), the 5-agent orchestrator, the shared RTO blacklist, and the Claude-style Copilot console. 11/11 pytest cases pass and 20/20 Playwright assertions pass (login, gating, greeting, 5 agent cards, right rail, KPIs, /agents/orchestrate wired to card click, logout + refresh gating, public funnel still renders).

issues: Canvas2D warning: MatrixRain/Constellation call getImageData without willReadFrequently=true — perf-only, no functional impact.

critical_code_review_comments: auth.py sets cookie with secure=True and samesite=lax — correct for the HTTPS preview domain, but local http testing (not required here) would fail; keep in mind for dev.

agents/orchestrate uses require_confirm_for_money+prepay/rescate as HITL trigger. When there is no order_id and no queue rows, rescate.action=='skip' → HITL never fires, so the frontend falls through to sendPrompt(). That matches the requested 'either send prompt OR open HITL' spec but means the HITL dialog cannot be exercised end-to-end from a clean DB without seeded queue rows.
Copilot.jsx: kpi.tasa_pct is read from metrics.norte.recovery_rate.value — if the metrics endpoint schema changes this silently shows 0; consider a small fallback badge.
Multiple canvas backgrounds (MatrixRain + Constellation) mounted at once on every gated page; consider mounting only on landing/login for lower CPU.
server.py registers novedades_router twice (lines 208 & 221) — harmless (FastAPI ignores dup routes with same path) but should be cleaned up.
test_credentials: qa2@litper.co / Litper!2026 (existing). A fresh qa+<timestamp>@litper.co org is created every pytest run — cleanup not implemented (documented in memory).
seed_data_creation: None mandatory. Pytest creates one TEST user + org per run for the register-success case.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend cookie auth uses HttpOnly cookie 'litper_session' + JWT. In Playwright, `page.request.post('/api/auth/login')` bootstraps the browser context cookie jar. The 5-agent orchestrator lives at POST /api/agents/orchestrate and DOES require X-API-Key (auto-injected by frontend api.js). HITL modal only opens when risk.prepay_required=true OR novedades yields days_left → rescate.action=='cadence_planned' — seed a queue row with days_left<=7 to exercise the HITL yes/no buttons end-to-end.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration.
